# `base/resizable`

The user sets the split between panes and the size should persist.

## Selection

- **Use when:** The user sets the split between panes and the size should persist.
- **Avoid when:** The split is fixed by the layout, or the region is a page shell.
- **Consider instead:** `layout/containers`, `base/structure`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { ResizableHandle } from "themelia-ui/base/resizable"
import "themelia-ui/base/resizable.css"
```

## Composition

This module depends on no other module.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `ResizableHandle`

Kind: callable.

The grip between two panels: a real `role="separator"`. It is focusable and takes arrow
keys, so the split is adjustable without a pointer.

```text
({ withHandle, className, ...props }: ResizableHandleProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `ResizableHandleProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `ResizablePrimitive.SeparatorProps`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `withHandle` | no | `boolean` | Draws a grip on the line, for a split with no other cue that it moves. The hit area is<br>wider than the 1px rule either way. |

### `ResizablePanel`

Kind: callable.

A panel inside a `ResizablePanelGroup`.

```text
({ className, ...props }: ResizablePanelProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `ResizablePanelGroup`

Kind: callable.

The split. `orientation` is its axis. Own the persistence: keep the layout in your state
with `onLayoutChanged` and hand it back through `defaultLayout`, so a reader who widened a
panel finds it wide next time.

```text
({ className, ...props }: ResizablePanelGroupProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `ResizablePanelGroupProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `ResizablePrimitive.GroupProps`, `Pick<ResizablePrimitive.GroupProps, "orientation">`.

No own members are present in the normalized public snapshot.

### `ResizablePanelProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `ResizablePrimitive.PanelProps`.

No own members are present in the normalized public snapshot.

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup } from "themelia-ui/base/resizable"
import { Text } from "themelia-ui/base/typography"

const FRAME: React.CSSProperties = {
	width: "100%",
	height: "12rem",
	border: "1px solid var(--border)",
	borderRadius: "var(--radius)",
	overflow: "hidden",
}

export default function Resizable() {
	return (
		<div style={FRAME}>
			<ResizablePanelGroup orientation="horizontal">
				<ResizablePanel defaultSize="65%">
					<div style={{ padding: "var(--space-lg)" }}>
						<Text size="sm" type="secondary">The document</Text>
					</div>
				</ResizablePanel>
				<ResizableHandle withHandle />
				<ResizablePanel defaultSize="35%">
					<div style={{ padding: "var(--space-lg)" }}>
						<Text size="sm" type="secondary">The inspector</Text>
					</div>
				</ResizablePanel>
			</ResizablePanelGroup>
		</div>
	)
}
```
